hero.sub: A small team of people, a partner venue, and an AI team that does the heavy lifting. Here is who is who, where to find us, and how to check that we are real.

items.name: Angeline "Chii" Viray
items.body: Maps how a business really runs, puts AI to work in it, and hands it over to the team.

items.name: Tristan Macabuag
items.body: Finds the businesses we can help and starts the conversation. Will lead our partners as that program grows.

ghost.title: The ghost team
ghost.body: A Chief AI Officer and six AI specialists. All of them are AI, and we label them that way. Chii decides and cross-checks their work.

advisors.title: Advisors
advisors.body: A few advisors who prefer to stay private. They advise Chii. They do not speak for the company.
